newsitem.title: HUNGARY: ING Barings ups Richter 's EPS, keeps buy.
newsitem.headline: ING Barings ups Richter 's EPS, keeps buy.

text.p: ING Barings said it upgraded its 1997 earnings per share (EPS) forecast for Richter Gedeon Rt, after the Hungarian pharmaceuticals firm reported strong Q1 earnings, and maintained a "buy" recommendation.

ING Barings revised its 1997 EPS forecast to 953 forints from 817 forints on Richter's "excellent margins due to the strong U.S. dollar, shift in product mix and higher sales growth thanks to the Russian market," it said in the May issue of its "Eastern Europe Monthly Review".
The report added that ING Barings upgraded its gross margin forecast from 61.2 percent to 62.2 percent and its sales growth forecast from 28 percent to 33 percent "based on a very strong 1Q 97".
After raising its net profit forecast from 14.2 billion forints to 16.6 billion in 1997, ING Barings raised its forecast for 1998 from 18.8 billion forints to 21 billion.
In 1996 Richter had an IAS net profit of 11.271 billion forints.
Richter released its first quarter earnings report on April 29 and reported an IAS net profit of 4.997 billion forints compared to 3.258 billion in the first quarter of 1996.
